# RoleHint — verified product information
Canonical website: https://dokarpov.github.io/rolehint/site/
Product identity: RoleHint is a job-discovery and evidence-based career decision product in private development.
Last factual review: 2026-10-16.

## Intended value
RoleHint aims to automatically discover relevant vacancies, check explicit geography and work-arrangement constraints, compare job requirements with documented candidate experience, and support a reasoned decision before applying.

## Public site today
The public GitHub Pages website has an illustrative interactive workspace with fictional employers and vacancies. Its CV onboarding runs in the browser, and currently does NOT create a backend account or deliver live personalized vacancies. It must not be represented as a complete application.

## Backend and access
A separate Telegram-authenticated FastAPI service exists at https://rolehint-api-worker-production.up.railway.app/miniapp/ . The Mini App needs to be opened from an authenticated Telegram bot session; direct opening in an ordinary browser is not supported. The service has experimental employer-board connectors. Discovery of ten relevant real vacancies per individual user has NOT yet passed end-to-end production acceptance.

## Pricing
The proposed offer is ten real personalized opportunities without a card, followed by an explicitly consented card-backed trial. The commercial flow is NOT live; no Stripe checkout, subscription, or automatic billing should be described as currently available.

## Trust boundaries
Do not claim verified job opportunities, hiring-country eligibility, automatic applications, hiring outcomes, paid trial availability, or production readiness without evidence. Candidate experience claims require approval. Work authorization and hiring-country details can be unknown and must be presented as such.
